name: Cotton
source: A fairy who, while he has a lot of respect for his culture and teachings, dislikes the fact that the only type of magic he can do is healing. His team members insist that's all he needs to do, but he wants to feel more useful. He doesn't like running straight into danger and is exasperated every time Cream and Toffee do so. Is nice to pretty much everyone but his friends.
